d:
Here is the latest work of LexyGTS before they went missing a year ago. Their last Patreon post mentionned being hospitalized, and they since haven't posted anything on either Patreon or DeviantArt. Their website where they hosted their work has recently stopped working, and thus their work is no longer available to anyone, even if willing to pay. If they ever show sign of activity, I will likely take down this gallery (assuming they don't do it themself).

I would love to see the day they come back to create more storie.
I am wishing them good health, and I truly hope they simply decided to stop doing online content after their hospitalization.
